sql.sql: SELECT "c"."active" AS "active", "c"."code" AS "code", "c"."concept_id" AS "concept_id", "c"."definition" AS "definition", "c"."display" AS "display" FROM "concept" "c" WHERE (("c"."cs_id" = @cs_id_3) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "found" FROM (SELECT * FROM "concept_literal" "cl" INNER JOIN "concept" "src" ON ("src"."concept_id" = "cl"."source_concept_id") WHERE (("cl"."property_id" = @prop_id_0) AND ("cl"."active" = 1) AND ("src"."cs_id" = @literal_cs_id_1) AND ("cl"."value_text" COLLATE NOCASE IN (@prop_value_2) OR (("cl"."value_text" IS NULL) AND "cl"."value_raw" COLLATE NOCASE IN (@prop_value_2))))) "r" WHERE (("r"."source_concept_id" = "c"."concept_id") AND ("r"."source_concept_id" IS NOT NULL)))) ORDER BY "c"."code" ASC LIMIT 100
